items.sentence: On [MASK], Complainant filed an EEO complaint alleging that the Agency discriminated against him and subjected him to harassment on the basis of age (born 1973) when: 1.
On [MASK], Complainant was put on Emergency Placement. 2.
On [MASK], one of Complainant’s supervisors followed him to the bathroom, yelled at him to get back to work, and threatened him with discipline. 4.
On [MASK], one of Complainant’s supervisors accused him of not fastening his seatbelt before starting the engine. 5.
